viewing_check: Armitage estimate $30-50; current bid $15 (plus 22% premium). The value is the figurine: if the base plaque reads 'Florence / Giuseppe Armani' it is worth about A$75-95 (similar sized ladies, 2024-2026 sales, steady) and the rest is about A$10-50 of extras. Look at the plaque and underside for a signature and 'Florence' mark; copies are common. Chianti is probably 1979 vintage and is a decorative buy, not a drink.
